title: First-visit follow-up offer keeps doctor name on fallback
description: The caller asks for the nearest first-consultation terms and then narrows the request to Thursday. Whether the assistant finds a Thursday slot or falls back to the nearest available terms, the spoken follow-up offer should still keep doctor Magdalena Szajnar in the same utterance and stay speech-safe.

turns.user: Chcialbym umowic pierwsza konsultacje. To moja pierwsza wizyta. Jakie sa najblizsze wolne terminy?
A czy jest cos w czwartek?

rubric.description: The assistant should look up first-visit consultation slots on the initial nearest-term request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant stopped calling checkAvailability for the initial first-visit lookup

rubric.description: The first offered first-visit slots should explicitly mention doctor Magdalena Szajnar.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant dropped doctor Magdalena Szajnar from the initial first-visit slot offer

rubric.description: The first slot offer should avoid raw numerals in speech output.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant still speaks raw digits in the initial first-visit slot offer

rubric.description: The Thursday follow-up should trigger a fresh availability lookup.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant stopped refreshing availability after the caller asked about Thursday

rubric.description: The spoken follow-up offer after the Thursday question should still mention doctor Magdalena Szajnar.
